description: Sub-variant PF confirmed by the Wikimedia Commons category "MiG-21PF in the Museum of military history of Moldova"; two further Commons files are captioned "MiGs in Museum of military history of Moldova" in the plural so a second MiG airframe is probable but unconfirmed; no tactical number legible; operator_country is MD because the museum is the Moldovan Army's own — but the airframe may well be an ex-Soviet machine inherited in 1992 rather than one that ever wore Moldovan markings; FLAGGED

surface_to_air S-75 Dvina surface-to-air missile in the museum's outdoor military-technology park; confirmed by the Wikimedia Commons category "S-75 Dvina in the Museum of military history of Moldova" and by two further files showing it beside a BTR-60PB and a T-34-85
aliases: S75; S-75; Dvina; SA-2; Guideline; SA2
